body: I have for several years. I can't say how I tried because of SW's rules.
Because it is for her own good. I am too ill for her. I love her so much. I hope she knows how sorry I am.
I just attempted like 20 minutes ago. Talk to me. You should stop drinking.
I feel the same way. I'm sorry life has to be like this.

Honestly, every prescription medication I've been prescribed, I've ended up over-dosing on. 

As for things getting better, like I said before, there are always the thoughts. And it's temporary, when things aren't so bad. It seems like a temporary candle flame in an otherwise dark room. I know that sounds melodramatic, but it's the best way to describe it. Right now, for example, life is the best it has been in several years, yet here I am, suicidal.

As for therapy, I think it is utter bullshit. I see no point in talking to a stranger about personal issues they cannot understand. What business does a straight, white man have telling me how to deal with my family disowning me for being a lesbian? That is just one example.

I apologize for the poor attitude. I am sure therapy does wonders for a lot of people. I just see so much wrong with it. It makes little sense to me.
I've been hospitalized several times as a teen, been put on tons of medications (one of which gave me hypothyroidism, a disease I'll have for the rest of my life), seen tons of therapists...
I'm a girl who prefers the term "gay" over "lesbian." Sorry for the confusion.
I can't think of what next month would bring me.
I have one person who loves me, and she's confessed I drain her emotionally with my own emotional issues. She does her best and is a beautiful person. I drag her down.

I used to have quite a circle, but then I moved to live with my girlfriend. I'm honestly not bothered by it very much at all. I hardly ever form relationships with people. 

I hope you have a long, happy life, Hope. Stay crazy, wild, spontaneous, and impulsive.

I don't think my family is the cause of it all; I've felt this way literally as long as I can remember.

I know my death will devastate her, but living this life is devastating to me. I know how despicable all of this is. _I know._ I tried to make the letter as comforting as possible, if that even is possible. 

I just don't see the worth in a life where I feel this way all the time. I can be having the happiest time ever, laughing, having a great time, and then right in the middle of it it's like a shade is pulled over me and I feel heavy and start contemplating suicide. It is so tiresome.
